candidate_state: released from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, rustfmt, clippy, opening-book release tests, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly package generation, package metadata validation, and generated JavaScript contracts passed. Version 0.4.2 improves search-boundary correctness, bounded training-data ingestion, reproducible performance evidence, and disabled-by-default search experiments without adopting a new default evaluator or making a general playing-strength claim.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.4.2. PGO throughput evidence remains a separate fixed-condition performance result, not a playing-strength claim.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
New search and Lazy SMP policies without an independent H1 remain disabled-by-default experiments.
The qualified PGO throughput result applies only to the recorded Apple M4 four-thread configuration; ordinary release builds do not embed that profile.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
